question.text: For INR-based currency futures, dynamic price bands are relaxed in increments of how much?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (pp.56-57 and p.150), there are no fixed daily price bands for INR-based currency futures. An operating range of +/-3% applies up to 6 months and +/-5% beyond 6 months, and when a market-wide trend is observed the dynamic price band is relaxed in 1% increments. The Trap: 5% is the operating range for longer-dated contracts, not the relaxation increment; 0.5% and 2% are not the source-backed step size. Note: The relaxation is dynamic, applied only on observed market-wide moves, and is in 1% steps.
